req.title: Reject malformed player payload
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 422 Unprocessable Entity when POST /players/ receives a body that fails Player schema validation.

doc.reasoning: R-PLAYER-009 requires POST /players/ to return HTTP 422 when the request body fails PlayerRequestModel schema validation. The PlayerRequestModel has three required fields (first_name, last_name, squad_number, position) and several optional ones. Tests must cover: (1) a valid payload succeeding with 201 (positive/EP), (2) a completely empty body returning 422 (negative/EP), (3) missing only one required field returning 422 (boundary/BVA), (4) wrong type for a required field returning 422 (negative/DT), (5) all required fields present but optional fields with wrong types returning 422 (negative/DT). Mutation resilience is achieved by asserting the exact status code integer 422 (not >= 400), checking the 'detail' key exists in the error body, and verifying 201 on the positive path to catch operator-flip mutations on the status code constant.

tests.name: test_post_player_valid_payload_returns_201
preconditions: squad_number 99 does not exist in the pre-loaded fixture
actions: POST /players/ with a fully valid PlayerRequestModel payload (all required fields present, correct types)
expected: Response body contains firstName, lastName, squadNumber, position, and id fields
trace: R-PLAYER-009 positive path — valid payload must NOT trigger 422
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

def test_post_player_valid_payload_returns_201():
    payload = {
        "firstName": "Test",
        "lastName": "Player",
        "squadNumber": 99,
        "position": "Goalkeeper"
    }
    r = client.post("/players/", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code == 201
    body = r.json()
    assert body["firstName"] == "Test"
    assert body["lastName"] == "Player"
    assert body["squadNumber"] == 99
    assert body["position"] == "Goalkeeper"
    assert "id" in body

test_post_player_valid_payload_returns_201()

tests.name: test_post_player_all_required_fields_present_no_422
preconditions: squad_number 95 does not exist in the pre-loaded fixture
actions: POST /players/ with exactly the minimum required fields (first_name, last_name, squad_number, position) and no optional fields
expected: Response body contains the submitted required fields and a generated id
trace: R-PLAYER-009 BVA — exactly all required fields present (boundary: minimum valid payload) must NOT yield 422; catches off-by-one on required field count
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

def test_post_player_all_required_fields_present_no_422():
    payload = {
        "firstName": "Boundary",
        "lastName": "Test",
        "squadNumber": 95,
        "position": "Centre-Back"
    }
    r = client.post("/players/", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code == 201
    body = r.json()
    assert body["firstName"] == "Boundary"
    assert body["lastName"] == "Test"
    assert body["squadNumber"] == 95
    assert body["position"] == "Centre-Back"
    assert "id" in body
    assert body["middleName"] is None
    assert body["dateOfBirth"] is None
    assert body["starting11"] is None

test_post_player_all_required_fields_present_no_422()
